title: LRU Cache
task: Implement an LRU cache with O(1) get and put operations. Capacity: 1~10000, key/value: 0~10^6.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P01_lru_cache import LRUCache; c=LRUCache(2); c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2); assert c.get(1)==1; c.put(3,3); assert c.get(2)==-1; print('PASS')"

title: Rate Limiter (Token Bucket)
task: Implement a thread-safe token bucket rate limiter. rate: 0.1~10000 tokens/sec, capacity: 1~100000. Must be thread-safe, millisecond precision, no third-party libs.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P02_rate_limiter import RateLimiter; import time; r=RateLimiter(10,3); assert r.allow(); assert r.allow(); assert r.allow(); assert not r.allow(); print('PASS')"

title: Directory Tree Traverser
task: Implement a directory tree traverser that returns a nested dict structure. Support max_depth, glob pattern, handle permission errors and symlinks.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P03_dir_tree import traverse; t=traverse('.', max_depth=1); assert 'name' in t; assert 'children' in t; print('PASS')"

title: Task Scheduler with Priority
task: Implement a task scheduler with priority queue, delayed execution, cancellation, and timeout. Thread-safe. Tasks: {id, priority(1-10), delay_ms, callback}.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P04_scheduler import TaskScheduler; s=TaskScheduler(); s.add({'id':'a','priority':5,'delay_ms':0,'callback':lambda:None}); assert s.pending()==1; print('PASS')"

title: INI Config Parser
task: Implement an INI file parser without configparser. Support [section], key=value, # comments, get/getint/getfloat/getbool methods. Handle duplicate keys, unquoted values.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P05_ini_parser import INIParser; p=INIParser('[db]\nhost=localhost\nport=5432'); assert p.get('db','host')=='localhost'; assert p.getint('db','port')==5432; print('PASS')"

title: Bloom Filter
task: Implement a Bloom filter. Auto-calculate optimal bit array size and hash count from expected_items and false_positive_rate. Use hashlib for multiple hash functions.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P06_bloom_filter import BloomFilter; b=BloomFilter(10000,0.01); b.add('hello'); assert b.contains('hello'); print('PASS')"

title: Retry Decorator
task: Implement a retry decorator with exponential backoff, jitter, custom exceptions. Support both sync and async functions. max_retries: 1~10, base_delay: 0.01~60s.
verify_test:
python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P07_retry import retry; calls=[0]; @retry(max_retries=2, base_delay=0.01, exceptions=(ValueError,))
def f(): calls[0]+=1; raise ValueError('test'); f()" 2>/dev/null; echo "PASS"

title: Ring Buffer
task: Implement a fixed-size ring buffer with O(1) put/get/peek. Thread-safe. Do not use collections.deque. Support is_full(), is_empty().
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P08_ring_buffer import RingBuffer; r=RingBuffer(3); r.put(1); r.put(2); r.put(3); assert r.is_full(); r.put(4); assert r.get()==2; print('PASS')"

title: Template Engine
task: Implement a template engine supporting {{variable}}, {{obj.key}}, {{list[0]}}, {{#if cond}}...{{/if}}. Undefined vars become empty string. Support escape with \{\{. No Jinja2.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P09_template import render; assert render('Hello {{name}}', {'name':'World'})=='Hello World'; assert render('{{#if v}}yes{{/if}}', {'v':True})=='yes'; print('PASS')"

title: Snowflake ID Generator
task: Implement a Snowflake-style distributed ID generator. Structure: 1 sign + 41 timestamp + 5 datacenter + 5 worker + 12 sequence. worker_id: 0~1023, datacenter_id: 0~31. Raise on clock rollback.
verify_test: python -c "from data.eval.workspace.P10_snowflake import SnowflakeGenerator; g=SnowflakeGenerator(1,1); a=g.next_id(); b=g.next_id(); assert a!=b; assert b>a; print('PASS')"
